label: Bible Study
prompt: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly _____:
verse: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:
note: A merchant finds one pearl of great price — and sells everything to get it.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And Mizpah; for he said, The LORD _____ between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.
verse: And Mizpah; for he said, The LORD watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.
note: The famous Mizpah blessing was first spoken by Jacob and Laban — two men who frankly didn't trust each other an inch.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to _____.
verse: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.
note: Paul's short list of Christian habits includes this one: 'given to hospitality' — keep the door open.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Behold, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom, pride, fulness of bread, and abundance of _____ was in her and in her daughters, neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
verse: Behold, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom, pride, fulness of bread, and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters, neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
note: Ezekiel's surprising list of Sodom's sins starts with pride, overfed comfort, and ignoring the poor.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: O foolish Galatians, who hath _____ you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?
verse: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?
note: 'O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you?' — Paul at his most exasperated with a church he founded.
